about: Items archive.org publishes for the systems beyond Windows 3.1, metadata only: counts and bytes (the sum of item_size, derived files included) by a search of subjects and titles, for sizing the audience (kb/guides/beyond-windows-31.md). Made by scripts/catalog/other-systems.mjs; no identifier is kept. catalog counts the Windows 3.x catalog's items that need Win32s, from catalog/results.json.

groups.about: archive.org's Software Library: Windows 3.x, every item, the WinHelp collection included: the catalog's source, for comparison.
Software items whose subject or title names Windows 95.
groups.query: mediatype:software AND (subject:"Windows 95" OR title:"Windows 95" OR subject:"Win95" OR title:"Win95")
